description: Once the container is closed, further update requests are silently ignored and the current value is left unchanged, so a later read reports the value as of closing. Subscribers that attach after closing are delivered only the final value followed immediately by a completion signal, and multiple late subscribers each independently observe that final value and completion. A subscriber that attaches before closing and one that attaches after closing both end up observing the same settled value and completion, reported in attachment order.

cases.expected_output:
subscriber=a values=[1] done=true
subscriber=b values=[1] done=true

subscriber=a values=[0] done=true
subscriber=b values=[0] done=true
